reviewer_requirements: Independent person/agent distinct from original author; declare conflicts and model/tool identity.
Review complete authorized source pages privately; quote no publisher passages into public artifacts.
Decide each claim as ACCEPT, REJECT or NEEDS_REVISION, with a reproducible independently obtained reference or counterexample.
Technical and pedagogy reviews require separate passes; a self-test cannot mark approval.
Revision of a claim resets its approval status; exceptions need explicit review owner.
